title: Clean, Pure, and the Pork Question
subtitle: What the Bible means by clean, holy, dirty and impure, why the pig was forbidden, and the two Christian readings of whether the ban still stands.
summary: Clean is not the same as holy, and dirty is not the same as impure. The four words, the difference between ritual impurity and forbidden food, why the pig stood out, and the strongest case on each side of the Christian debate over eating pork.
aiNote: Rough draft for review: the Verses Across team's own essay, edited and fact-checked with AI. Scripture is quoted from the King James Version and Pickthall's Qur'an on this site. Both Christian positions are presented in their own terms; the site does not take a side.
